handoff.objective: Let me check at any time whether the protected governance files have changed since an engineering work order was authorized, without having to run a review to find out.
handoff.result: Added company/engineering/verify.py: one work order's protected surface re-digested against a named checkout, with three statuses so an unanswerable question cannot read as clean. Wired a read-only `verify` CLI command whose exit code is the answer. 8 new tests.
risks: The check compares bytes, so a whitespace-only edit to a protected file reads as drift. That is deliberate but will produce a finding a reader has to dismiss.
